ns2:section.sectionText: This course is restricted to Mathematics, Math&CS, and Stat&CS majors initially, but the restriction will be removed during business hours on May 5, 2021. Current Statistics majors may consult with a Statistics advisor to determine whether they are eligible for an override before the restriction-remove date. Some seats are reserved for on-campus transfer students in majors requiring this course. Any remaining seats would be released on the Friday before fall classes begin.
